name: Port wine
where: Taylor's or Graham's cellar shops in Vila Nova de Gaia
about: Porto's famous sweet fortified wine, aged and bottled across the Douro River in Gaia. It is the city's signature drink.
tip: Miniature bottles are also sold, so you can try several styles before buying full sizes.

name: Claus Porto soap
where: Claus Porto shop on Rua das Flores
about: A soap brand founded in Porto. Its boxes have a vintage look that suits the city's history.
tip: Choose your scent first, then decide between the classic and retro-style packaging.

name: Azulejo tile
about: Hand-painted or printed ceramic tiles. Azulejos decorate many buildings in Porto and show its artistic tradition.
tip: Ask whether the tile is handmade or printed, because the prices differ a lot.
